mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200.0 thousand units signals weakening residential construction and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1200.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 3.0%) indicates a strong economy without excessive price pressures, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and CPIAUCSL below 3.0% fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS rising) consistently supports consumer demand and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth above 2.0%), the economy faces overheating risks and potential Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
